contenders.handicapper_notes: Top selection on Class Drop Elevator (+1 tier from Randwick Sat BM78 $112K to Warwick Farm midweek $42K within 18 days, finished 3.7L off winner). Post-scratch Lone Speed (+6 boost) as the sole E runner in the 7-horse field. Draws the pole barrier 1 for Waterhouse/Bott with Regan Bayliss and carries a light 123lbs (~55.8kg). Will dictate an uncontested tempo on a +3m on-pace favoring track, though rises in class from a Hawkesbury Maiden win and faded over this 1600m trip two back on Soft.

Strong swooper (S) who posted a career-best 78 speed rating when flashing from 14th to 2nd by 0.7L over this exact Warwick Farm 1600m course on Oct 21. Proven Soft-track winner (2-from-4) and rock hard fit 4th-up, though rising to 129lbs (~58.5kg) and settling off a soft pace behind Koibito are slight negatives.

Danger Horse. Swooper (S) trained by Chris Waller who gets a major jockey upgrade to James McDonald from barrier 2 at a light 123lbs (~55.8kg). On a quick 7-day backup after finishing strongly from last for 5th (1.6L) over 6.5f here, now stepping up Sprint to Route to 1600m by wet-track sire Maurice.

Resuming 1st-up after being gelded since tackling the G1 Queensland Derby (1.5m) in May; no class drop bonus due to long layoff and >5L margin. Tactical P style and proven 1st-up winner at 1600m on Soft (plus a 7.8L Heavy win), but must overcome the widest barrier 7 and heavy 137lbs (~62.1kg) impost prior to Shannen Llewellyn's claim.

Presser (P) drawn well in barrier 4 to sit handy behind Koibito and Azarax. Drops sharply in weight to 120lbs (~54.4kg) before Siena Grima's apprentice claim after fading to 7th (3.1L) under 130lbs over this track and trip 7 days ago. Placed in two prior metro runs and rates an exotic hope.

Deep closer (C) who gets a light 119lbs (~54.0kg) with Kerrin McEvoy aboard 3rd-up. Has beaten only two runners home across two starts this prep at Warwick Farm and faces an unfavorable slow-tempo race shape.
